firstPlayerRule: In real-time play, both Captains call “Dive!” to begin, then each Captain gives orders at their own pace. There is no individual first player.
houseFallback: For turn-by-turn play, agree which team starts before beginning.
clarifications: The turn-by-turn mode alternates between Captains; each must let the opponent finish before announcing a new direction.
